description:
Young lads Ruth and Innis study together at Magia Magic Academy. They know each other and confront for a long time. The new bet, they arranged causes unpredictable consequences, as Innis drank the love potion, made for the teacher Tien. Suddenly, the relationships between Ruth and Innis change completely.
